user.title: Connect FlashForge AD5X
user.description: Powered-on printers on your LAN are auto-discovered below! Simply select your printer and enter the 8-character LAN Check Code from the AD5X touchscreen (or enter IP & Serial manually if the printer is currently powered off at a smart plug).

modules.title: Power, Notifications & Optional Modules
modules.description: Select an optional smart plug and mobile notification targets, and choose which optional features to enable. Disabled modules won't clutter your device with unused entities.

data.enable_timelapse: Enable Configurable Timelapse Capture & MP4 Compiler
data.enable_obico: Enable Obico ML Add-on (App) & Failure Detection
data.enable_files: Enable Printer File Browser & Print Launcher

spoolman.title: Spoolman Configuration
spoolman.description: Connect your Spoolman server (v0.27.0+ recommended for native NFC tag UID linking). When new filament is inserted into an IFS slot, you'll receive a notification to pick a spool, scan a QR code (`WEB+SPOOLMAN:S-{id}`), or scan an NFC tag.

data.snap_printer_colors: Snap Filament Colors to AD5X 24-Color Palette

camera.title: Camera & Timelapse Configuration
camera.description: Choose between an External Camera (an existing Home Assistant camera entity or RTSP/HTTP URL), the AD5X's Native Camera, or Both.

data.native_stream_override: Native AD5X Stream URL Override (Blank = Auto)
data.timelapse_crop: Optional External Crop Filter (w:h:x:y, Blank = Full Frame)

obico.title: Obico ML Configuration
obico.description: Link your Obico ML Home Assistant App (Add-on) so it automatically starts when the printer turns on and stops when off to save RAM, enables detection while printing, and alerts/pauses on detected spaghetti.

data.obico_stop_delay_sec: Stop Obico App Delay After Printer Offline (seconds)
